sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gentle Annie, also called Gentle Annis, is a Scottish folkloric figure. She is a supernatural hag with blue-black skin. She served as the weather spirit who brought raw winds down Cromarthy Firth. Her flattering name has been linked to the ancient goddess Anu. Her form and nature resemble the Cailleach.

okr.objective: Document Gentle Annie as a Scottish supernatural hag and weather spirit.
